research_question: Did the fictional Republic of Testland's 2088 'Lantern Subsidy' for night markets raise monthly stall revenue, relative to markets in unsubsidised districts?
data_description: Panel of 120 invented night markets over 10 months (2087M9-2088M6). Variables: market_id, month, treated (1 = subsidised district), post (1 = from 2088M1), revenue (log monthly stall revenue index).
institutional_context: In this made-up setting the subsidy was assigned by district lottery announced in 2087M12 and paid from 2088M1.
